## B3a preparatory research checkpoint, 2026-10-24 KST

This is a recoverable exploratory note, NOT a source-branch push, independent review or B1/B2 admission change. Owner HEAD remains28b7705cbb236c26e1b273335f6da7e9da4d1aaf. Central B1->B2->B3->B4->B5 ordering is preserved: this independent algebraic reference does not activate the B3 coupled solver or close the unresolved historical pytest argv/old-budget provenance gaps.

The latest preserved B1 comment6373136365 records actual Dropbox whole-byte S1/S2 recovery and a partial historical wall subtotal34.1262904040002s. Reuse it; do not repeat archive intake or infer a remaining120-minus-subtotal budget. The current Python/container probes returned SERVICE_ERROR; no compiler absence inferred. Wolfram15.0.1 is executing a DISTINCT lightweight reference unit. Requested evaluator ceilings consumed so far90s of a new120s aggregate cap; actual measured kernel work is much smaller and reported per call. Old campaign remaining budget remainsnull. New cosmological IVPs=0, old replays=0, NCP=0.

### New derived and CAS-checked result
With eta=diag(-1,1,1,1), T_hat=kappa L^2 T_gamma, u=gamma(1,beta), chi=L*n_e_rest*sigma_T:
Qhat_gamma=chi*(T_hat.eta.u+u*((eta.u).T_hat.(eta.u))), Qhat_e=-Qhat_gamma.
Actual CAS: u.u=-1 residual0; u.Q=0; rest force{0,-chi*f}; isotropic force(4chi*rho/3)*gamma^3*{beta^2,beta,0,0}; beta3/5,rho3,chi1 gives{45/16,75/16,0,0}. In normal time, Qhat0=beta.Qhat_sp for this elastic model. Thus normal-frame energy exchange is bulk work, not electron-rest heating.

New numerical defect control: naive subtraction in Qhat0 produces0 at beta1e-12 and1e-9 where exact values are approximately4e-24 and4e-18. At beta1e-6 the relative error is8.890058e-5. Computing spatial force first and Qhat0=beta.Qsp removes this specific cancellation in the tested isotropic states. It is NOT a universal cure near every equilibrium.

For isotropic rest-frame line emission, alpha=-u.Qhat is NONZERO and Qhat=alpha*u. General identity Qhat0=beta.Qsp+alpha/gamma must be used instead. The elastic shortcut must not erase the REC photon/atomic-internal energy pair. Inspected native_line_owner.py blobcb36a10b19b9b60c046383389f9706bd9970222f at rec_bianchi a7c46fd...: energy pair is explicit, odd injection0, STF injection is a RATE not current stress.

Exact scalar unpolarized Thomson phase integrals yielded lambda_0,lambda_1,lambda_2={1,0,1/10}. Therefore zero four-force does not imply zero quadrupole evolution. This is a known-model consistency result, not a new no-go theorem or a full polarized closure.

### Coding state, preserve failures
New Wolfram reference wrapper tests: initial missing-interface RED0/8; first implementation5/8 (nested pure-function metadata bug); repaired candidate20/21. The remaining failure is real: an unbalanced momentum record was not rejected because Return inside Do did not terminate the enclosing intended assembly path. It is being repaired by validating all record balances BEFORE accumulation. Do not mark this candidate complete. Its generated source SHA256 is ed68710a0d63c31c8ac061ffb91e8a083784ad9abda276ba9201d5ba2021710d.

The20 surviving groups include12 exact Lorentz covariance cases,6 independent rest-frame-formula comparisons, emission-versus-elastic distinction, SI c-factor, small-beta controls and other guards. No Python execution or independent-model review is claimed. Next action is the one targeted assembly repair/regression, then a source+results checkpoint; guarded source push remains pending independent review.
